THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Declaration under Section 5

I, Kuragamage Don Lal Kantha, Minister of Agriculture, Livestock, Land and Irrigation, do hereby declare under Sub-section (1) of Section 5 of the Land Acquisition Act, that the land described below is needed for a public purpose and will be acquired under the provisions of the Land Acquisition Act.

An Allotment of land depicted as following Name and extent in the Advance Tracing Maha/MDD/2020/765 dated 27.05.2022 prepared by the Surveyor General, situated at the Village of Rambukpotha in No. 807, Rambukpotha Grama Niladhari Division, in Udasiyapattuwa South Korale Minor Division, in the Divisional Secretary’s Division of Medadumbara, in Kandy District, Central Province and bounded as follows:

01. Lot ‘A’ - Dehigollehena - Extent: 0.7841 Hectare North: Bambaragan Oya and Lot No. 3 in P.P.7867 ; East; Lot No. 3 and 4 in P.P. 7867; South: Lot No. 4, 10 in P.P. 7867 and Water-way; West: Water-way and Bamdaragan Oya. K. D. Lal Kantha, Minister of Agriculture, Livestock, Land and Irrigation.
